all.headline: Trump says Israel and Lebanon’s leaders will speak on Thursday
all.description: US president says the leaders of the two countries will speak for the first time in 34 years on Thursday.

all.headline: Hopes grow for a breakthrough in US-Iran talks as Pakistan mediates
all.description: Pakistani sources say there has been a 'major breakthrough' over a deal on Iran’s nuclear programme.

all.headline: Democrats clash with US Energy Secretary over Iran war and gas prices
all.description: Watch the moment a Democratic congresswoman tells the US Energy Secretary he is ‘living in a different world’.

all.headline: Pakistan expecting ‘major breakthrough’ tied to Iran’s nuclear programme
all.description: A source has told Al Jazeera that Pakistan is expecting a breakthrough tied to Iran’s nuclear programme.

all.headline: Israeli forces fire stun grenades at journalists in occupied Nablus
all.description: Video shows Israeli forces firing stun grenades towards journalists who were reporting on the army’s raid of Nablus.

all.headline: Brazil’s fugitive ex-spy chief freed in the US after ICE detention
all.description: Alexandre Ramagem, who fled Brazil following his conviction for plotting a coup, was held by ICE in Florida on Monday.

all.headline: Russian attacks on Ukraine kills three, including a 12-year-old child
all.description: Kyiv's mayor says the attacks hit Podilskyi and Obolonskyi districts, causing fires and damage to residential buildings.

all.headline: Huge crowds greet Pope Leo in Cameroon 20 years after outreach trip
all.description: Huge crowds have greeted Pope Leo in Cameroon, returning to a country he visited 20 years ago as ‘Father Bob’.

all.headline: Iran war live: Pakistan in push for new round of US-Iran peace negotiations
all.description: At least 2,167 people have been killed and more than 7,000 injured in Israeli attacks on Lebanon since March 2.

all.headline: El Salvador publishes law allowing life sentences for minors as young as 12
all.description: The new sentencing measure comes as President Nayib Bukele oversees a four-year-long state of emergency against crime.

all.description: The BBC's chief international correspondent reports from Iran as diplomatic efforts to avoid a return to war intensify.

all.headline: Israeli triple-tap strike kills three paramedics in Lebanon, officials say
all.description: Lebanon's government condemns as a "flagrant crime" the killing of the paramedics, one of whom featured in a BBC report.

all.headline: Prominent Palestinian prisoner Marwan Barghouti assaulted three times in a month, family says
all.description: The Israeli Prison Service says the allegation that Barghouti was subjected to physical violence by prison guards are "false and baseless".

all.headline: Israel and Hezbollah continue attacks after Israel-Lebanon talks in US
all.description: Israel strikes hit southern Lebanon and Hezbollah fires rockets at Israel, a day after rare direct negotiations.

all.headline: Sri Lanka repatriates 238 Iranian sailors stranded after US torpedo attack
all.description: The survivors of the US attack on Iranian vessel Iris Dena, which claimed the lives of 104 people, were among those sent home.

all.headline: Trump hints Iran talks could resume this week as US port blockade continues
all.description: The United Nations' secretary general said it was "highly probable" that the negotiations would restart.

all.headline: Lebanon seeks peace, but Hezbollah needs to be convinced first
all.description: The Lebanese government go into peace talks with limited influence over the group.

all.headline: The Israeli town on the frontline with Hezbollah
all.description: BBC foreign correspondent Nick Beake visits Metula, an Israeli town surrounded on three sides by Lebanon.

all.headline: Israel and Lebanon hold first direct talks since 1993
all.description: A US statement said the two sides had agreed to launch direct negotiations, at a time and place to be determined.

all.headline: Italy suspends defence agreement with Israel
all.description: The Italian PM said the pact, which happens every five years, would be suspended "in view of the current situation".
